hints.title: Layered State Graph
hints.text: Reaching a city with d discounts used constitutes a distinct subproblem from reaching it with a different discount count.

hints.title: Dual Edge Transitions
hints.text: From each state, either traverse an edge at standard cost without using a coupon, or spend a coupon to pay floor half toll.

hints.title: Early Destination Return
hints.text: Because costs are non-negative, the first time the destination city is extracted from the priority queue gives the optimal answer.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O((E * K) log(V * K)) Dijkstra state shortest path
complexity.space: O(V * K) distance array and priority queue
complexity.notes: Maintain min distance table keyed by city and remaining discount coupons.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy discount usage on the first high edge may prevent discounting even larger edges downstream.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Extending vertex states by discount count forms a layered shortest path graph.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should model state as (city, discounts_used) and execute Dijkstra search.
